mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of months when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue growth and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and depressing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods (CPIAUCSL>3.0% and FEDFUNDS rising), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1250.0) indicate strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of months when HOUST > 1250.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of months when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In strong labor markets (PAYEMS > 150000), declining employment (PAYEMS falling below 149000) signals impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150000 and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
